features.title: Agent-published HTML page as a sandboxed card
features.summary: The html_render agent tool publishes a self-contained HTML page (chart, mockup, table) that the chat transcript shows as a card: a sandboxed iframe themed with the DSH light/dark tokens, resizable, with Copy HTML, Open in new tab and Expand to full screen. The card stays visible after the Turn completes (Chat's PinnedToolCalls keeps it outside the "Completed in" fold). The page is persisted in the tool result's presentation metadata, so a reload shows it again; the model gets only a one-line summary.
reach:
fill textbox "Message or run a task, / commands, @ files or sessions" "[[call html_render {\"title\":\"Sales dashboard\",\"html\":\"

Q3 revenue

Script blocked

\",\"height\":300}]]"
failureModes: HTML above 512 KB (UTF-8) is refused with an error that names the size and how to shrink or split the page.
The page has no network: external scripts, stylesheets, images, fonts, fetch and form posts are blocked by its Content-Security-Policy; only inline code and data:/blob: media load.
The frame runs scripts without same-origin, so the page cannot read DSH cookies, storage or the Host API; it can still navigate its own frame when the user clicks a link.
Open in new tab is blocked by a browser that refuses pop-ups; Copy HTML and Expand still work.

verification.testName: persists the page as presentation metadata and tells the model only a summary
refuses a page over the size cap with a recovery path
puts the no-network policy first in the head and drops base and http-equiv elements
reads live Host tokens in auto mode and refuses values that could escape the stylesheet
keeps the page inside a sandboxed srcdoc frame whatever its markup contains

features.title: Workspace HTML file shown as a sandboxed card
features.summary: The html_preview agent tool shows an HTML file from the calling thread's workspace in the same sandboxed, themed card as html_render. The path is relative to the thread working directory and must resolve (symlinks followed) inside the thread workspace. Relative ,
reach:
fill textbox "Message or run a task, / commands, @ files or sessions" "[[call write {\"file_path\":\"index.html\",\"content\":\"

Workspace page

Shown from the thread workspace

\"}]]"
fill textbox "Message or run a task, / commands, @ files or sessions" "[[call html_preview {\"path\":\"index.html\",\"title\":\"Workspace page\"}]]"
failureModes: A path outside the thread workspace (relative, absolute or through a symlink) is refused with the workspace path and the html_render alternative.
A missing file, a non-.html file, a non-UTF-8 file or a page above 512 KB after inlining is refused with an error that says how to fix it.

Assets outside the workspace, missing, of an unknown image type, too large for the remaining budget or beyond 32 references stay unresolved and are listed in the model's summary; CSS url(), @import, fonts, srcset and remote URLs are never inlined.

verification.testName: shows a workspace file with its simple relative assets inlined
refuses a path outside the workspace, including through a symlink, and never inlines an outside asset
refuses non-HTML, missing, oversized and non-UTF-8 files with a recovery path
